prerequisite_definitions.guest_entry: Guest can attempt public category/configurator entry; login not fixture requirement.
prerequisite_definitions.base_selectable: Named active base/SKU selectable in intended fixture.
prerequisite_definitions.ingredients_selectable: Named ingredient/SKU selectable for chosen base; ratio admissibility assessed separately.
prerequisite_definitions.normal_admissible: Normal recipe satisfies structural bounds, compatibility, pigment cap and quantity before successful evaluation/add assertions.
prerequisite_definitions.cart_add_path: Plan supplies guest/cart/quantity/actions needed to attempt successful add; required product add behavior may itself be defective.
prerequisite_definitions.initial_and_changed_admissible: Both initial and changed recipes satisfy structural bounds, compatibility, pigment cap and quantity; ratio change can attempt valid evaluations.
prerequisite_definitions.food_admissible: Admissible recipe with source-supported food-compatible components reaches classification evaluation.
prerequisite_definitions.nonfood_admissible: Admissible recipe with source-supported non-food components reaches summary evaluation; missing product guidance is asserted behavior, not setup failure.
prerequisite_definitions.evaluable_rejection: UI-constructible, structurally valid recipe can reach evaluation that rejects compatibility or policy; disabled choice/invalid field alone insufficient.
prerequisite_definitions.correction_admissible: Specific correction from evaluated rejection yields structurally and policy-valid recipe, compatible materials and applicable quantity.
prerequisite_definitions.existing_saved_line: Independent valid saved cart fixture or reachable earlier successful add establishes original line/composition; unavailable seed is unknown, product edit defect is not setup failure.
prerequisite_definitions.edit_admissible: Changed edit recipe satisfies structural bounds, compatibility, pigment cap and quantity; plan can attempt save on existing line.
